Wakers17
Coffee & Juice

A vibrant, character-led café brand built around the spirit of the confident adventurer — bold enough to be recognised on any street in Amman.

Amman, Jordan
Brand Identity · Packaging · Signage
Project Overview

The Confident Adventurer — a café that wears its personality out loud.

Wakers17 is more than a coffee shop. It's a haven for people who navigate life with self-assurance and an unquenchable thirst for exploration. The brand needed an identity as bold and expressive as its clientele — one that communicates energy, creativity, and belonging from the first glance.

The identity system spans logo design, colour architecture, packaging, signage, and brand applications — all anchored by the custom typeface Blue Cashews and a multi-colour palette mapped to the menu categories.

Identity System

Logo system — dark green / bright green / gold emboss / dimensional applications

Colour Architecture

Each colour maps to a product category — not just a visual system, but a navigational one. The full palette covers coffee, juices, sweets, and food.
